review_reasons: Requires new mathematics: A fully rigorous treatment requires: (1) A category-theoretic framework that unifies the different manifestations of symmetry breaking across domains, (2) Rigorous mathematical formulation of Goldstone's theorem that works in both classical and quantum settings, (3) Precise characterization of 'spontaneous' selection mechanisms in deterministic systems, (4) Mathematical framework for emergent properties that bridges microscopic symmetries and macroscopic order
